messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Triplet: ["Ozempic", "has note about dose equivalence", "no equivalent dose of Rybelsus for Ozempic 1 mg"]

The relation 'has note about dose equivalence' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a note indicating that there is no equivalent dose of the specified drug for a particular strength.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has unstudied dose': The subject drug has not been studied at the dose specified by the object entity.
B. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug does not share a chemical structure or mechanism of action with the substance specified by the object entity.
C. 'has maximum dose': The subject drug should not exceed the maximum dose specified by the object entity.
D. 'has no identified risk of': The subject drug has not been associated with the specified risk or adverse outcome in available data.
